g.text: Smart System2: success vs. online Astra token cost

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526277

g.text: Higher success and fewer tokens are better. Separate cohorts; horizontal scales differ.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526277

g.text: Cost = all reported input + output tokens / all evaluated task-reset cases, including failed attempts.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596779

g.text: ≥ marks incomplete provider usage: one call each for occlusion and direct steering. These token costs are lower bounds.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596779

g.text: Experiment B: zero online calls; whole teacher-source studies used ≥6.89M tokens. Exact selected-teacher acquisition cost is unknown.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596779

g.text: FRS is a three-case development result. Compare methods within each panel; retries, resets and prompt/vision workloads differ.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596779

g.text: This figure excludes development/interruption overhead for the 20-case studies, teacher acquisition, robot-policy compute and coding-agent tokens.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596779

g.text: Larger FRS run: 952 recorded rollouts, 5/20 tasks fully audited before the spending cap; full-cohort SR is unavailable.
